subtasks: Insert and tighten each screw into the nut of the same color.
Install the loose red nut on the fixed red bolt and screw it down upright.
Recover the tilted red nut, orient its bore upright, then seat and tighten it on the red bolt.
Fully open both grippers and return both arms to their initial poses, leaving the matched nuts on their bolts.
Tighten the already seated pink nut and yellow nut farther clockwise on their matching bolts, keeping each centered and upright. Use the right gripper for pink and the left gripper for yellow.
The yellow, pink, and red nuts have been turned and released on their matching bolts. Keep both grippers fully open and return both arms to their initial poses.

Use the right arm to screw the upright pink nut farther clockwise on the fixed pink bolt, regrasping as needed until the bolt cap is nearly flush with the nut's top. Leave the yellow and red pairs in place and keep the left gripper open at home.
Keep both grippers fully open and return both arms to their episode-start poses, leaving the three seated nuts in place.
